metadata.description: A personal marketplace of reusable skills, MCP integrations, and agent workflows.

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: Plan-driven software development with subagent delegation: explore, plan, execute, and review.

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Git commit, push, and pull-request workflows with a fixed safety floor: stage by name, refuse staged secrets, and — in the pull-request flow — never put a commit on the remote default branch.

plugins.name: arch
plugins.description: The owner's technology-selection knowledge base: decision frameworks with their reasons, one skill per domain.

plugins.name: coflux
plugins.description: Connect Claude Code to the coflux agent command center: hooks report live turn states and inject the session's coflux coordinates at start, the coflux skill documents the local commands for terminals the user can watch and take over, and the bundled MCP config wires up the center's coflux MCP server.

plugins.name: market
plugins.description: Prepare and onboard Claude Code plugins into a user-selected marketplace using its delivery and contribution requirements.
